events.text: The squadron was established as Patrol Squadron 25 (VP-25).
events.subject: self
events.quote: established as Patrol Squadron 25 ( VP-25 ) on 20 April 1944

events.text: The squadron was redesignated Patrol Bombing Squadron 25 (VPB-25).
events.subject: self
events.quote: redesignated Patrol Bombing Squadron 25 ( VPB-25 ) on 1 October 1944

events.text: The squadron was redesignated Patrol Squadron 25 (VP-25).
events.subject: self
events.quote: redesignated Patrol Squadron 25 ( VP-25 ) on 15 May 1946

events.text: The squadron was disestablished.
events.subject: self
events.quote: disestablished on 28 June 1946

events.text: The first VP-25 was redesignated VP-23.
events.subject: other
events.quote: the first VP-25 was redesignated VP-23 on 1 August 1941

events.text: VP-25 was established at NAAS Harvey Point, North Carolina, under the operational control of FAW-5.
events.subject: self
events.quote: 20 April 1944 : VP-25 was established at NAAS Harvey Point , North Carolina

events.text: The squadron was sent to NAS Key West, Florida, for operational training in Anti-submarine warfare.
events.subject: self
events.quote: 26 June 1944 : The squadron was sent to NAS Key West , Florida

events.text: The squadron returned to NAAS Harvey Point.
events.subject: self
events.quote: returning to NAAS Harvey Point on 4 July 1944

events.text: The squadron remained at NAAS Harvey Point until it departed for NAS Alameda, California.
events.subject: self
events.quote: remained at NAAS Harvey Point until 18 August 1944 , when it departed for NAS Alameda

events.text: VP-25 reported to FAW-14, NAS Alameda for orders.
events.subject: self
events.quote: 21 August – 29 September 1944 : VP-25 reported to FAW-14 , NAS Alameda for orders

events.text: Orders were issued for departure.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Orders were issued for departure on 15 September 1944

events.text: The remaining two aircraft arrived.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: The remaining two aircraft arrived on 29 September 1944

events.text: VP-25 was redesignated VPB-25, coming under the operational control of FAW-2.
events.subject: self
events.quote: 1 October – 14 November 1944 : VP-25 was redesignated VPB-25 , coming under the operational control of FAW-2

events.text: Orders were received for the squadron to report to the combat zone.
events.subject: self
events.quote: until orders were received for the squadron to report to the combat zone on 14 November 1944

events.text: VPB-25 departed Hawaii for San Pedro Bay, Leyte, Philippines.
events.subject: self
events.quote: 15 November – 1 December 1944 : VPB-25 departed Hawaii for San Pedro Bay , Leyte , Philippines

events.text: The latter arrived on station.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: The latter arrived on station by 22 November 1944

events.text: VPB-25 began its first daytime combat sector patrols.
events.subject: self
events.quote: VPB-25 began its first daytime combat sector patrols on 1 December 1944

events.text: VPB-25 received orders to transfer its operations to Mangarin Bay, Mindoro, Philippines.
events.subject: self
events.quote: 25–29 December 1944 : VPB-25 received orders to transfer its operations to Mangarin Bay , Mindoro , Philippines

events.text: The squadron aircrews flew from San Pedro Bay to rejoin the rest of the squadron and the two tenders at Mangarin Bay.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 29 December 1944 , the squadron aircrews flew from San Pedro Bay to rejoin the rest of the squadron and the two tenders at Mangarin Bay

events.text: The squadron began conducting sector searches from the new location.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The squadron began conducting sector searches from the new location the next day

events.text: One of the squadron's aircraft was damaged by anti-aircraft fire and forced down near Tam Quam, Indochina.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: 29 January 1945 : One of the squadron’s aircraft was damaged by anti-aircraft fire and forced down near Tam Quam , Indochina

events.text: VPB-25 was transferred to Jinamoc Seaplane Base, Leyte, Philippines, under the operational control of FAW-10.
events.subject: self
events.quote: 6–25 February 1945 : VPB-25 was transferred to Jinamoc Seaplane Base , Leyte , Philippines , under the operational control of FAW-10

events.text: The squadron transferred six aircraft back to Mangarin Bay.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: the squadron transferred six aircraft back to Mangarin Bay on 25 February 1945

events.text: The squadron's Mangarin Bay detachment received orders to relocate to Manila Bay, off Cavite Naval Base.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: 7 March 1945 : The squadron’s Mangarin Bay detachment received orders to relocate to Manila Bay , off Cavite Naval Base

events.text: The Cavite detachment was relocated to Lingayen Gulf.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: 24–28 June 1945 : The Cavite detachment was relocated to Lingayen Gulf

events.text: The squadron commenced Black Cat nighttime operations against enemy shipping.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Operations commenced with the squadron conducting Black Cat , nighttime , operations against enemy shipping on 28 June 1945

events.text: The Cavite detachment was transferred to Puerto Princesa, Palawan, Philippines.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: 9 July 1945 : The Cavite detachment was transferred to Puerto Princesa , Palawan , Philippines

events.text: This detachment was relieved to rejoin the rest of the squadron at Lingayen Gulf.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: This detachment was relieved on 23 July to rejoin the rest of the squadron at Lingayen Gulf

events.text: USS San Pablo arrived on station at Lingayen Gulf to relieve USS Currituck.
events.subject: other
events.quote: 20 August – 3 September 1945 : USS San Pablo arrived on station at Lingayen Gulf to relieve USS Currituck

events.text: USS Pocomoke was relieved on 3 September 1945.
events.subject: other
events.quote: USS Pocomoke was relieved by on 3 September 1945

events.text: VPB-25 was assigned duty with the occupation forces in Japan.
events.subject: self
events.quote: 22 March 1946 : VPB-25 was assigned duty with the occupation forces in Japan

events.text: VPB-25's duty with the occupation forces in Japan ended.
events.subject: self
events.quote: through 1 May 1946

events.text: VP-25 was disestablished.
events.subject: self
events.quote: 28 June 1946 : VP-25 was disestablished

events.text: The squadron was assigned PBM-3D aircraft.
events.subject: self
events.quote: PBM-3D - 20 April 1944

events.text: The squadron was assigned PBM-3D2 aircraft.
events.subject: self
events.quote: PBM-3D2 - 6 February 1945

events.text: The squadron was assigned to NAAS Harvey Point, North Carolina.
events.subject: self
events.quote: NAAS Harvey Point , North Carolina - 20 April 1944

events.text: The squadron was assigned to NAS Alameda, California.
events.subject: self
events.quote: NAS Alameda , California - 21 August 1944

events.text: The squadron was assigned to NAS Kaneohe Bay, Hawaii.
events.subject: self
events.quote: NAS Kaneohe Bay , Hawaii - 15 September 1944

events.text: The squadron was assigned to NAS Kaneohe Bay.
events.subject: self
events.quote: NAS Kaneohe Bay - May 1946

events.text: The squadron was assigned to NAS Alameda.
events.subject: self
events.quote: NAS Alameda - May 1946
